items.title: WeatherNext 2: Our most advanced weather forecasting model
items.summary: The new AI model delivers more efficient, more accurate and higher-resolution global weather predictions.
items.summaryZh: Google DeepMind推出了WeatherNext 2气象预测模型，该模型在效率和准确性上均有显著提升。相比前代，其预测速度提升了8倍，并支持高达1小时的分辨率。该模型利用TPU进行计算，能在1分钟内生成数百种天气场景，目前已集成至Google Cloud Vertex AI及Earth Engine等平台，为全球供应链和交通决策提供支持。

items.title: OpenAI named Emerging Leader in Generative AI
items.summary: OpenAI has been named an Emerging Leader in Gartner’s 2025 Innovation Guide for Generative AI Model Providers. The recognition reflects our enterprise momentum, with over 1 million companies building with ChatGPT.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI被Gartner评为生成式AI模型提供商的“新兴领导者”，主要基于其企业级应用规模的增长。
